name: After Hours #48 — Last Cat Asleep
description: Cups empty, cats clocked out. Rain making the window the best seat in the house. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 48 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 3-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
